Risk Description: No named accountable owner for AI hiring outcomes
Regulatory Driver: EU AI Act Art. 26(1); CO SB 24-205
Treatment: Assign Talent Manager as accountable owner; record in AI use-case inventory

Risk Description: AI system procured through ATS renewal with no risk review; no use-case inventory
Treatment: Establish AI use-case inventory reviewed quarterly

Risk Description: Vendor contract lacks audit rights model-change notification and discrimination indemnity
Treatment: Amend contract at renewal; add 30-day model-change notice and exit-on-audit-failure

Risk Description: Recruiters untrained on score derivation and override authority
Treatment: Deliver training plus mandatory override reason field

Risk Description: Proxy discrimination via employment gaps graduation year and ZIP code
Regulatory Driver: Title VII; ADEA; IL HB 3773 (ZIP prohibited)
Treatment: Remove or neutralise proxy features; monitor residual effect

Risk Description: Model fine-tuned on vendor cross-client historical hiring outcomes encoding prior bias
Treatment: Require training-data documentation; validate via independent audit

Risk Description: Non-linear histories and disability-related gaps read as instability
Treatment: Remove gap-length feature; recruiter training on limitations

Risk Description: No job-relatedness analysis linking scored features to role performance
Treatment: Document job-relatedness per feature; remove features that fail

Risk Description: No adverse-impact monitoring; selection rates by protected group never calculated
Regulatory Driver: Title VII four-fifths rule; NYC LL144
Treatment: Monthly impact-ratio monitoring by role family with 0.80 trigger

Risk Description: Vendor bias audit inadequate - superseded model version non-intersectional vendor-commissioned
Treatment: Commission independent audit covering production model version

Risk Description: No model-drift detection; scoring behaviour can shift without alert
Treatment: Add drift monitoring; contractual model-change notification

Risk Description: Rejection decisions not logged with score and feature contributions
Regulatory Driver: EU AI Act Art. 26(6); CO records
Treatment: Log score top features recruiter action and outcome; retain 3 years

Risk Description: Auto-rejection below score 40 removes human review for ~4400 candidates per year
Regulatory Driver: CO SB 24-205; IL HB 3773; Title VII
Treatment: Disable auto-reject threshold; ranking advisory only

Risk Description: No candidate appeal or human-review request channel
Regulatory Driver: CO human review right; NYC LL144 notice
Treatment: Publish candidate notice and human-review request route

Risk Description: No kill switch - no defined trigger or authority to disable scoring
Treatment: Define triggers and single named authority to disable

Risk Description: No incident process for AI-caused discriminatory outcome
Treatment: Extend incident response plan to cover AI outcome incidents
